$comment: L74 release gates. Changing a threshold or the allowlist needs review: see docs/REGRESSION.md.

allowlist.reason: Pinned exactly by @mastra/mcp 2.4.1; the fix needs @mastra/mcp 2.7.0, which requires @mastra/core >= 1.79 (platform pinned on 1.78.0). MCP HTTP servers run only inside lab runs, bound to 127.0.0.1 with per-run bearer tokens and torn down after the run; the public API exposes no MCP endpoint.
Same dependency path and exposure as GHSA-f897-62hf-6gxq: each lab run creates its own loopback server and transport; no transport is shared between clients.
Same dependency path; loopback-only fixture servers reachable by the lab's own client, never by learners or the network.
Same dependency path; the L49 facade issues a fresh random token per run for one loopback server, so a token for another service never exists in this deployment.
Moderate (below failOn); listed for the record. The MCP client only connects to loopback fixture servers; remote MCP servers are release-gated.
Moderate (below failOn); listed for the record. serveStatic is not used; the package is only the MCP node transport's HTTP server on loopback.
